hero.title: Meet Boomertanger
hero.lede: Horror streamer, engineer, husband, dad of two, and the human of a corgi named Skipper. This is where his story starts.

chapters.title: Get to know Boomer
chapters.lede: Boomertanger is a reflection of the guy who built it. Three sides of him, one card each.

chapters.title: Blueprint behind the boom
chapters.lede: It didn't start with a brand. It started with a kid on an island, a ColecoVision and a lot of curiosity.

chapters.title: His edge: built for horror gaming
chapters.lede: Why fans keep coming back, and why developers and other creators team up with him.

chapters.title: Base Camp and beyond
chapters.lede: A growing fanbase, a new site and a lot more to build.

personality: Boomertanger pulls you into a world that's anything but ordinary. He's playful, a bit mischievous, and keeps things fresh, weird and very entertaining.
Just when you think you've figured him out, he flips the script with some unapologetic sass. He's bold and cheeky, and he isn't afraid to stir the pot.
Under all of it is a guy who keeps pushing forward. He keeps making things, keeps connecting with people, and won't settle for a stream you'd forget.
bubble: Think you've got me figured out?

sides.sub: Scared of horror. Plays it anyway.

edge.title: He loves horror. It gets him every time.
edge.text: Games, movies, the slow build and the jump. He's a lifelong fan and he still screams. That's the fun of it.

edge.title: Indie horror is home.
edge.text: Small studios, strange games, and the Granny Gauntlet that blew the channel up in June 2025.

edge.title: Chat is in the game.
edge.text: Viewers remember the codes, pick the route and call the escape when it all goes wrong.

edge.title: Mods are part of the team.
edge.text: They help set the tone of the chat and keep it welcoming and fair. He trusts them with real say, and he gives them the credit.

edge.title: Built by an engineer.
edge.text: He started in R&D systems engineering in 2000, on projects for the Army, the Navy and NASA. He runs his stream setup the same way, and he built the site you're on.

beyond.opener: More cinematic horror, more chaos you can steer from chat, and more ways to be part of the story.

askBoombot.q: Why is it called Base Camp?
askBoombot.a: It's the starting point. Before you climb into the streams, this is where you find out who Boomer is, where he came from and what makes his streams his.
Yes. Scary games and movies genuinely terrify him. He plays them anyway because he loves the suspense.
Twitch is the main stage, TikTok is where a lot of people find him, and YouTube keeps the streams and highlights. The schedule shows when he's on next, in your own time zone.

askBoombot.q: What does the Fan Club open here?
askBoombot.a: Fan Club is free. On this page it opens the full story: all three sides of Boomer, every stop on the trail and what's coming next.
